libraries.recommendation: Vendor stock zlib-1.2.1 source under third_party (checksum-pinned like Lua). Do not hand-reconstruct any of the mapped functions; record them in the ledger as library matches. Create Ghidra functions at 00bcbf40 and 00bcacf0 (and scan [00bc94d0,00bcf910) for other undefined code) before applying names. Behavioural parity for the game only needs the public API used by the 8 wrappers (compress, uncompress, inflateInit_/inflateInit2_, inflateReset, inflate, inflateEnd, deflateInit_). Byte-identical matching needs VC8 (VS2005) /O2; with VS2022/2026 only, use Ghidra fuzzy hashing (find_similar_functions_fuzzy / bulk_fuzzy_match) against a local build for symbol confirmation.
